name: Negi
description: Thick white spring onion used more like a leek than a garnish.

tcm.note: Cong bai is warm and releases the exterior — the classical first-chill remedy.

ayurveda.note: Ushna and tikshna, as all alliums are.

nutrition.highlight: a leek, in all but name

guna.note: Fresh and simple — the sattvic default for plant food eaten close to how it grew.
